rows.mof_business_term: Sum of invoice line net amount
rows.transformation_rule: Derive IBT-106 as the sum of IBT-131 line net amounts under IBR-CO-10
rows.notes: Derived from taxpayer line data; distinct from IBT-109 and not a separate header source field.

Read invoice total tax amount from headers.vat_total
Read invoice total amount with tax from headers.total_incl_vat
Read amount due for payment from headers.amount_due
Group IBT-131 by normalized category and applicable significant rate; return not_evaluated unless document adjustments are positively absent
rows.notes: P1.7 is required for categorized document allowances/charges; IBT-116 is not a taxpayer-source field.

rows.transformation_rule: Calculate in invoice currency from IBT-116 and category treatment; reconcile rounded sum to IBT-110
rows.notes: Do not aggregate AED-oriented BTUAE-08; P1.7 dependency is explicitly not_evaluated.

rows.transformation_rule: Normalize IBT-151 and emit one IBT-118 value for each category and applicable-rate group
rows.notes: Repeatable output is derived; the optional header tax_category_code is compatibility metadata only. P1.7 is required when document adjustments are not positively absent.

rows.transformation_rule: Normalize applicable IBT-152 and emit one IBT-119 value for each rate-applicable breakdown group
rows.notes: No rate is invented for rate-inapplicable categories such as E/O; the optional header tax_category_rate is compatibility metadata only.

Read item net price from lines.unit_price

rows.transformation_rule: Derive line payable amount in AED from line net plus applicable VAT; multiply by BTAE-04 for non-AED and round to two decimals
rows.notes: Derived runtime evidence; no separate taxpayer source column.
